summary: Attempt 2 repairs every review-001 defect without changing the one-successor plan. DS-005/DS-006/T109 now bind every market state, run transition and checkpoint to the exact canonical MarketCursor, define post-event/post-transition query boundaries, preserve the original audit-chain ordinal within a cursor, and cover same-block actions, delayed fills, initial state and end-of-block queries. T104 is now an explicit T109 dependency and remains the sole fee-growth/range-fee projection composed by T088/T103 with provenance. THREAT_MODEL adds the current T109 controls and T-22; TRACEABILITY moves current T069/T105 authority to T109 while retaining predecessor evidence. T109 now specifies and tests a compatibility adapter for approved T101/T106 and their T102 path. No existing task contract or business code changed.
rationale: Review-001 identified specification incompleteness, not an Owner ambiguity. T061 orders its append-only audit chain and uses integer timestamps, while the canonical market order is the chain event key; inferring one from the other later is ambiguous. The repair therefore records the exact MarketCursor and a global run_transition_ordinal during the original run. MarketState(cursor) is post-market-event; RunState(cursor) is the recorded initial state plus every transition bound at or before cursor, after all same-cursor transitions. Decisions/risks bind their trigger cursor, latency/fills bind the actual fill-data cursor, and unbindable state evidence prevents success. T040/T041 do not own fee-growth globals, whereas approved T104 already publishes cursor-addressable fee-growth prefix state and exact range queries, so the repair keeps fee fields outside core MarketState and composes T104 rather than inventing a fee path. New T109 manifests replace embedded market input with immutable T100 references, but approved T101/T106 logically consume run/dataset/pool/range/registry/schema bindings rather than the physical list representation; T109 therefore owns a versioned adapter that resolves identical canonical bytes for T101, preserves the T106 manifest view, and proves T102 integration without reopening T069/T105 publication. Security and traceability collateral now state that cutover explicitly. No further Owner decision is required.

impact_assessment.intent: Unchanged from attempt 1: G-HISTORICAL-REPLAY-01 and G-RUN-REPLAY-01 preserve canonical MarketState, exact saved RunState and composed ReplayFrame, with no per-run market copy, strategy rerun, parallel engine or per-point snapshot mandate. This retry clarifies their deterministic cursor semantics without changing product scope or intent_revision.
impact_assessment.specification: DS-005 defines exact cursor as post-event, block-only as end-of-block, and pre-first-event as the declared initial pool state. It explicitly excludes fee growth from T040/T041 MarketState and composes T104 as the sole dataset/window/cursor/reconstruction-bound projection. DS-006 binds every transition/checkpoint during the original run to a MarketCursor plus global run_transition_ordinal and defines post-transition RunState, delayed-fill and checkpoint boundaries. DS-007 composes post-event MarketState with same-cursor-complete RunState. WEB-PAGE-009/013 retain T104 provenance and prohibit a replacement fee calculation. ARCHITECTURE records the T104 ownership and T101/T106/T102 compatibility boundary. THREAT_MODEL updates T-17/T-21 and adds T-22 plus its matrix row.
impact_assessment.contracts: No pre-existing contract changed relative to the original A0022 base. Added T109 remains the sole new contract and still replaces T069/T105. It now depends on T104, makes exact cursor/ordinal production and post-transition projection binding, prohibits a replacement fee implementation, and carries explicit T101/T106/T102 compatibility and regression obligations. The same ten existing-task impacts remain open; T088 and T103 dispositions now explicitly preserve T104 semantics/provenance.
impact_assessment.dependencies: T109 dependencies are now T041,T052,T061,T069,T100,T104,T105; the graph remains acyclic. T104 is consumed, not replaced. The later CONTRACT amendment still repoints T073,T084,T087,T088,T103,T107,T108,T096; T088/T103 must retain their existing T104 consumption. Approved T101 and T106, plus T102 downstream, need no contract rewrite because T109 preserves their logical fields through an adapter, but T109 cannot complete without their regression/integration evidence. The safe order remains downstream CONTRACT repair, annotation-only SUPERSEDE of T069/T105, then T109 implementation/review.
impact_assessment.implementation: No code changed. T109 must capture cursor bindings at original-run time, persist audit ordinal, and project existing T061/T052 state; it may not infer cursor from timestamp. It composes T040/T041 and T104, never reimplements them. The compatibility adapter resolves T100 references to the same canonical event bytes for T101, presents unchanged registry/schema binding to T106, and proves the T102 path while making predecessor publishers unreachable.
impact_assessment.data: Simulation evidence now has an unambiguous composite position: exact MarketCursor plus monotonic run_transition_ordinal, and checkpoints additionally record last applied ordinal. Initial state is explicit; delayed fill is stored at its actual later event cursor. Core MarketState omits fee-growth; T104 projection carries dataset hash, window, cursor and reconstruction revision. New manifests use T100 references; old T069/T105/T063 artifacts remain byte-identical and legacy-readable. The T101 adapter returns identical canonical ordered event bytes and fails on content/reference mismatch.
impact_assessment.operations: Run success remains atomic across manifest/report/evidence. A transition without an exact canonical cursor, a duplicate/inconsistent ordinal, a T104 provenance mismatch, or a T101/T106/T102 compatibility mismatch prevents new-format successful publication. Pre-first and end-of-block reads have specified results; legacy runs remain explicitly unavailable for exact RunState. Rollback never restores current predecessor publication.
impact_assessment.security: THREAT_MODEL now treats substituted market/run state, current-strategy rerun, timestamp inference, final-summary substitution and alternate fee calculation as T-22. Controls bind dataset/hash/cursor/ordinal, use immutable evidence, preserve T104 provenance and refuse legacy regeneration. T-17/T-21 and the controls matrix identify T109 as current authority and T069/T105 as predecessor evidence. Replay evidence still grants no risk, approval, signer, execution, paper or live authority.
impact_assessment.verification: Author-side investigation only: workflow validate, import-graph, acceptance and git diff --check pass. Citation check has exactly the pre-existing T069 missing-module finding also present at the base; this retry adds none. T109 acceptance now explicitly covers same-block multiple actions, cursor then ordinal ordering, delayed fill absent at decision cursor/present at fill cursor, pre-first initial state, end-of-block inclusion, missing/duplicate cursor/ordinal rejection, T104 provenance/equivalence/no-replacement checks, and T101/T106/T102 positive and mismatch regression/integration with predecessor publication unreachable. Independent plan review remains required.
